description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rambadagalla, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land parcel information, cadastral map numbers, and property descriptions. The content focuses on land title registration and property claims rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories. The mention of the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement is incidental to the land administration function, not the primary focus of the gazette.
